en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a lakeside promenade in a landscaped park. A curving path runs along the water's edge, bordered by young trees and shrubs. Across the lake, densely wooded banks rise toward ornate late‑19th‑century villa or hotel buildings with turrets and steep roofs, set against a forested hillside. On the right foreground, a well‑dressed man in a long coat and hat and a small girl in a patterned dress and wide‑brimmed hat stroll along the path, suggesting an upper‑class leisure scene from the turn of the 20th century. A tiny boathouse or pavilion sits at the shoreline of a small wooded island in the lake.
